passages.title: Platform Announcement
passages.text: Due to emergency track repairs, all trains departing from Platform 4 are cancelled until 14:00. Passengers for the 13:15 service to London should proceed to Platform 7 for an alternative departure.

passages.title: Airport Security Notice
passages.text: Liquids, gels, and aerosols must be in containers of 100ml or less. All items must fit into a single, transparent, resealable plastic bag. Please remove this bag from your hand luggage before reaching the security scanner.

passages.title: Lost Property Office
passages.text: If you have left personal belongings on a train or at the station, please visit the Lost Property Office located near the main entrance. We hold items for 30 days before donating them to charity.

passages.title: Ticket Machine Warning
passages.text: The ticket machines in the West Hall are currently out of order. Please purchase your tickets at the ticket office or use the mobile app to avoid a penalty fare on the train.

passages.title: Airport Shuttle Bus
passages.text: The shuttle bus to Car Park C leaves every 15 minutes from outside the Arrivals hall. Please have your parking ticket ready for inspection by the driver upon boarding.

questions.question: What should passengers for the London train do?
questions.explanation: The notice states passengers should go to Platform 7 as an alternative.
options: b) Go to a different platform to catch their train.
c) Cancel their journey to London.

questions.question: What must passengers do with their liquids at security?
questions.explanation: The text requires passengers to take the bag out of their luggage for scanning.
options: a) Take them out of their bag for inspection.
b) Keep them inside their hand luggage.

questions.question: What happens to lost items after a month?
questions.explanation: The text says items are held for 30 days before being donated.
options: a) They are given away to a charity.
b) They are sold at the station.
c) They are kept in the office indefinitely.

questions.question: How can passengers avoid paying a penalty?
questions.explanation: The notice suggests buying tickets at the office or via the app.
options: a) By waiting until they are on the train.
b) By using the machines in the West Hall.
c) By buying a ticket before boarding.

questions.question: What should passengers have ready for the bus driver?
questions.explanation: The text specifies that the parking ticket must be ready for inspection.
